comments.author: B!
comments.body: The fact this guy has cat breeding instantly makes him bad for spice runners. You need fire prevention not cat breeding

comments.author: Kevin
comments.body: The fact that this guy has persuasion makes him perfect for spice runs. You can starve your crew (more room for spice) and not have to worry about mutinies.

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body:
Well it's said that persuasion doesn't work properly (or at least that's what Nicola claims on the persuasion page - I haven't been able to verify it myself). Anyway Id recommend Erda more as a spice runner aide. She has a very similar set of skills, but also has fire prevention skill, which I think is more important to have so your spices are far less likely to burn.

On the other hand, Joseph is only one of two aides to have both Cleaning and Cat breeding skill (the other being Alicia) which are two common - and annoying - ship problems to occur.

comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body: Wystein was kind enough to confirm that Persuasion does work as advertised. I'm not a spice runner, but that's good to know for those who are interested in starving and dehydrating their sailors for a few extra ducats. ;)
